description: Registry of SENTINEL LLM prompts. Each entry names the prompt file (prompts/<name>.md), its consumer, the model it is sent to, and the placeholders it requires. Tests enforce that placeholders here match the file.

classify_events.purpose: Batch-classify news items into the SENTINEL event taxonomy (one JSON line per item).

cluster_events.purpose: Group classified items that describe the same real-world incident.

event_analysis.purpose: Two-to-three sentence 'why it matters' note for new high-salience events.

council_framework.purpose: Shared CMR framework, glossaries, evidence tiers, and interpretive rules for the synthesis analyst.

council_synthesis_role.purpose: Synthesis-analyst role instructions and JSON output contract.

council_quality_judge.purpose: Score a council synthesis on specificity, grounding, and calibration.

relevance_gate.purpose: Pass 1 of codebook v3: headline-only relevance screen for batches of items (structured output).

code_event_v3_system.purpose: Pass 2 of codebook v3: coder instructions plus the rendered codebook. Sonnet 5.5 chosen 2026-09-30 after the three-coder comparison (see CHANGELOG).

code_event_v3.purpose: Pass 2 of codebook v3: one article with its lede, coded to codebook.item_schema() (structured output). Sonnet 5.5 chosen 2026-09-30 after the three-coder comparison (see CHANGELOG).
